newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says CPI trend puts it on path to EMU.
newsitem.headline: Spain says CPI trend puts it on path to EMU.

text.p: The Economy Ministry said on Friday the latest inflation data confirmed prices are on a downward trend which puts Spain on the right path for European economic and monetary union.

The Consumer Price Index rose a lower-than-expected 0.2 percent in September following a 0.3 percent gain in August. Year-on-year, inflation fell to 3.6 percent in September from 3.7 percent in August.

"The data confirm the downward trend of inflation in the Spanish economy and underline the need for all economic and social agents to coordinate efforts to achieve the inflation objective for the whole year," the economy ministry said.
"This puts us on the right path for complying with the inflation criteria set by the Maastricht Treaty..." the ministry said.
